meta.split_rule: Rows are ordered by sha1 of "nextcells-v1:<id>"; those whose first hex byte is below 0x40 are the tuning sample, the only rows the prompt or normaliser may be adjusted on; every other row is held out and reported. Dial: seed and fraction; the fixed seed is the reported one.

class_map.baseline: majority class among labelled held-out rows (computed at build)

meta.label: none stated for the whole cell (unscored)
meta.fold_rule: A guessed class becomes a sheet field only where held-out hits beat the majority baseline over the labelled held-out rows (PWC2); otherwise the sheet drops it and the note says model tier, unchecked.

fold.class_guess: not folded (does not beat the majority class on held-out rows)
